rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Sits between AI assistants and databases, providing authenticated MCP access with role-based access control. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, and SQLite with built-in SQL tools, filesystem tools, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, Microsoft Entra ID SSO, and full audit trail. Includes a React admin UI for managing connections, users, and tool permissions.
